notes.text: Available in cPanel 82 and later. Disabled when the Web Server role is disabled. Operates on domains owned by the selected cPanel account; ip is required and no default is documented.

ip is forwarded unchanged. The pinned examples include single IPv4/IPv6 addresses, full and implied IP ranges, IPv4/IPv6 CIDR notation, hostnames resolved by the server and an octet prefix such as 10. The client performs no address expansion or resolution.

Blocks access to the account domains immediately. The source declares no rollback; the client performs no automatic retry or rollback. Removing a block allows access from the affected address or range.
Returns the server-translated IP address string list or explicit null. Empty lists remain empty; an absent data member is a payload mismatch.
